description.blurb: S/2004 S 34 is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: S/2004 S 34 is about 3 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1414.59 days, at an inclination of 166° to the ecliptic, in a retrograde direction and with an eccentricity of 0.235.
